sections.heading: Article 1 (Purpose)
body: These Terms govern the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between METAPICK (the "Service") and its users in connection with the League of Legends match-lookup service the Service provides.

list.text: means the League of Legends match lookup, champion statistics, patch notes, and related web services provided by METAPICK.
means a person who has signed in to the Service and entered into a usage agreement under these Terms.
means a person who uses the Service without signing in.

sections.heading: Article 3 (Effect and Amendment of the Terms)

list.text: These Terms take effect when posted within the Service.
The Service may amend these Terms where there is a reasonable ground to do so, and will announce any amendment within the Service.
A Member who does not agree to the amended Terms may delete their account. Continuing to use the Service after the amended Terms take effect is deemed acceptance of the amendment.

sections.heading: Article 4 (Provision of the Service)
body: The Service provides the following features.

list.text: League of Legends summoner match lookup
Champion statistics and analysis
Patch note information
Leaderboard information
Other features the Service may develop
The Service is provided 24 hours a day, year-round in principle, but may be suspended temporarily where operationally necessary, such as for system maintenance.
Non-members may use basic features such as match lookup; some features may be available only to signed-in Members.
Sign-up is performed through Google OAuth. Signing in is deemed acceptance of these Terms and the Privacy Policy.
Members are responsible for keeping their account information accurate.
Members may not transfer or lend their account to any third party.

sections.heading: Article 7 (Account Deletion and Loss of Membership)

list.text: A Member may request account deletion at any time, and the Service will process it immediately.
The Service may restrict or revoke membership in the following cases.
sub: Intentionally interfering with the operation of the Service
Violating applicable law or these Terms

sections.heading: Article 8 (Suspension of the Service)
body: Where the Service cannot be provided due to system maintenance, natural disaster, or other force majeure, the Service may be suspended temporarily after prior notice. Where prior notice is not feasible, notice may be given after the fact.

list.text: The Service is provided free of charge, and is liable for damages arising from use of the Service only to the extent provided by applicable law.
Match and statistical data provided by the Service is based on the Riot Games API, and its accuracy and completeness are not guaranteed.
The Service is not liable if a user fails to obtain the profit or outcome they expected from using the Service.
Copyright in content created by the Service belongs to the Service.

League of Legends and related trademarks are the property of Riot Games, Inc. METAPICK is not endorsed by Riot Games and does not reflect the views or opinions of Riot Games or anyone officially involved in producing or managing League of Legends.
Disputes between the Service and a user shall in principle be resolved through mutual consultation.
If consultation fails, the laws of the Republic of Korea shall govern, and jurisdiction shall be determined under the Civil Procedure Act.

sections.heading: 1. Purposes of Collection and Use
body: METAPICK (the "Service") collects and uses personal information for the following purposes.

list.text: Member identification and sign-in authentication
Providing the League of Legends match-lookup service
Usage analytics and quality improvement
Preventing abuse and maintaining service stability

groups.heading: a. Collected on Google OAuth sign-in
c. Information entered by the user
items: League of Legends summoner name and tag (when linked by the user)

sections.heading: 3. Retention and Use Period
body: Personal information is destroyed without delay when the account is deleted or the purpose of collection is fulfilled. Where retention is required by law, it is kept for the period required.

list.text: Sign-in records: until the account is deleted
Access logs: 3 months

sections.heading: 4. Provision to Third Parties
body: The Service does not provide users' personal information to third parties, except where required by law.

list.text: Information is destroyed without delay once the retention period expires or the account is deleted.
Electronic files are permanently deleted by unrecoverable means; paper documents are shredded or incinerated.

sections.heading: 6. User Rights and How to Exercise Them
body: Users may exercise the following rights at any time.

list.text: Request access to personal information
Request correction or deletion of personal information
Request suspension of processing
Request account deletion

footer: You can exercise these rights through the contact below, and we will act without delay.

sections.heading: 7. Cookies
body: The Service uses cookies to maintain sign-in sessions and improve the user experience. You may refuse cookie storage through your browser settings, but some features such as sign-in may then be unavailable.

sections.heading: 8. Privacy Officer and Contact
body: This Service is operated by an individual. Please submit privacy-related inquiries through the link below.

sections.heading: 9. Changes to This Policy
body: This Privacy Policy may be revised in response to changes in law or service policy, and any change will be announced within the Service.
